target: UTM bundled QEMU profile, AArch64 PCI, virtio-ramfb, disposable disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-xcaliber-utm-qemu-2026-11-09.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-xcaliber
checks: X-Caliber launched and dismissed its help popup.
Plain left and right arrows moved the player ship; Space produced a visible projectile.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal, which accepted and executed commands; the full GUI regression tail passed.
scope_note: This is a headless run using UTM's bundled QEMU profile, not visible UTM app-window or Pi hardware acceptance.
